title: LOVE (The Final Discipline)
style: cinematic electronic anthem, warm powerful male vocal NZ/AU accent, builds from single note to full orchestral electronic wall of sound, emotional finale of the entire discipline series, genuine not sentimental, breath audible, no pitch correction, silence as punctuation, [PERSONA_NAME] voice, V4_5ALL, 110 BPM
lyrics:
```
[INTRO — spoken]
Every culture.
Every discipline.
Every tradition.
Ends here.

[VERSE 1]
Agape — the Greek love beyond desire
Bhakti — devotion — love as inner fire
Ubuntu — love as we — not me
Aroha — the Māori love that sets free

Ahavah — the Hebrew love that acts
Amor — the Latin love that facts can't track
Love as daily practice — not a feeling
Love as the foundation — not the ceiling

[CHORUS]
Love is the discipline
The final layer
Love is what the A.I. cannot give you
Love is what the human is the keeper
ENAMOUR — to inspire with love
That's the whole stack — above below and above
Love first — truth second — rest — presence — service
Love is the reason all of it has purpose

[VERSE 2]
Michelle — Ruby — Wesley — the house crew
Rhihana Kelvin Gustavo — this is for you
Gold ticket in your hand — boleto de oro
Love made the layer — love made the protocol

Thirty years of songs scared to release
Love is what opens the vault at last
ENAMOUR: INSPIRE — the name says it all
Love is the layer underneath it all

[BRIDGE — spoken, Corey direct]
I am good at listening — not speaking.
I watch. I walk. People notice.
I will outlast them all in the boardroom.
Three words when they expect twenty.
All energy directed.
That is love.
That is discipline.
That is the same thing.

[FINAL CHORUS — wall of sound]
Love is the discipline
The final layer
Love is what the A.I. cannot give you
Love is what the human is the keeper
ENAMOUR — to inspire with love
That's the whole stack — above below and above
Love first — truth second — rest — presence — service
Love is the reason all of it has purpose

[OUTRO — single voice, returns to silence]
Inspire with love.
Then break.
The coffee kicks in after.
The eyes say the rest.

ENAMOUR.
ZYNTHIO.
ZYNCONTEXT.
Love.
```
